name: ERCOT GIS Report / Generation Interconnection Status
pagination: No pagination for file download; IceDocListJsonWS lists dated report files by reportTypeId=15933.
fetch_method: curl page -> parse reportTypeID 15933 -> curl JSON list https://www.ercot.com/misapp/servlets/IceDocListJsonWS?reportTypeId=15933 -> curl XLSX via https://www.ercot.com/misdownload/servlets/mirDownload?doclookupId=1258020955
notes: Priority source. curl HEAD/page/list/download all public HTTP 200. Latest tested GIS_Report_July2026 was published 2026-08-03; Summary sheet says ERCOT was tracking 1906 generation interconnection or change requests as of 2026-07-31. Workbook sheets include Summary, Project Details - Large Gen, Project Details - Small Gen, Inactive Projects. Date fields are Excel serials and should be normalized.

name: PJM Serial/Cycle Service Request Status
pagination: API accepts rowCount/startRow; tested totalRows=9263. Browser export endpoints also exist.
fetch_method: curl public page -> parse JS /dist/interconnectionqueues.*.js -> call https://services.pjm.com/PJMPlanningApi/api//Queue/GetFilteredQueues? with api-subscription-key header E29477D0-70E0-4825-89B0-43F460BF9AB4, Origin and Referer. Metadata at QueueMetadata/getmetadata.
notes: Brief URL /planning/service-requests/interconnection-queues is stale and redirects to /not-found. Current page/API are public, but API returns 401 unless called with the page's subscription key and browser-like headers. Metadata exposes projectName, stateProvinceName, countyName, projectStatus, mw/mwe/mwc, fuelType, projectSubmittedDate, revisedInServiceDate, actualInServiceDate, transmissionOwner.

name: MISO Generator Interconnection Queue
pagination: Direct JSON endpoint returns full array; interactive page uses DataTables and offers browser CSV export.
notes: Brief URL /planning/generator-interconnection/queue/ redirects to MTEP and is stale. Current GI Queue page and JSON API are public. API fields include projectNumber, applicationStatus, queueDate, inService, transmissionOwner, county, state, studyCycle, studyGroup, studyPhase, svcType, poiName, summerNetMW, winterNetMW, fuelType and postGIAStatus. Some newest 2026 rows have blank county/state/fuel fields.

name: SPP GI Active Requests
pagination: No obvious pagination; single public HTML table with about 1029 project rows.
fetch_method: curl -L https://www.spp.org/engineering/generator-interconnection/ to discover link, then curl -L https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GIActive and parse HTML table.
notes: Public HTML table is large but directly fetchable. Fields include GI number, IFS queue number, cluster, nearest town/county, state, TO at POI, proposed in-service date, commercial operation date, capacity MW, max summer/winter MW, service type, requested injection/deliverability, nameplate capacity, generation type, fuel type, substation or line, request received, date withdrawn, status and study links.

name: NYISO Interconnection Queue
pagination: No pagination; direct XLSX workbook with active, withdrawn and in-service sheets.
fetch_method: curl -L -O direct XLSX linked from https://www.nyiso.com/interconnections
notes: Direct XLSX HEAD returned HTTP 200 with spreadsheet content type and content-length 250354. Workbook sheets: Interconnection Queue, Withdrawn, In Service. Parsed counts: 301 active rows, 1487 withdrawn rows, 153 in-service rows. HEAD content-disposition showed filename NYISO-Interconnection-Queue-06-30-2024.xlsx and Last-Modified 2024-10-25, so freshness should be checked against NYISO page before production ingestion.

name: ISO-NE Generator Interconnection Queue / IRTT Public Queue
pagination: Public HTML table plus Excel export link /reports/exportpublicqueue. Basic curl -L may loop; curl with cookie jar succeeds.
fetch_method: curl -L -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt https://irtt.iso-ne.com/reports/external; optional Excel export at https://irtt.iso-ne.com/reports/exportpublicqueue with same cookie handling.
notes: ISO-NE landing page https://www.iso-ne.com/system-planning/interconnection-service/interconnection-request-queue is public and points to IRTT. Tested IRTT with curl cookie jar: first 302 sets AspxAutoDetectCookieSupport=1, then HTTP 200 HTML content-length about 3.6 MB. Parsed 1752 table rows including header. Fields include Cluster, QP, Updated, Type, Requested, Alternative Name, Unit, Fuel Type, Net MW, Summer MW, Winter MW, County and Project Status.

name: CAISO Public Queue Report
pagination: No pagination; direct XLSX workbook. Page also links cluster-specific queue reports and RIMS.
fetch_method: curl -L https://www.caiso.com/generation-transmission/generation/generator-interconnection to discover report, then curl -L https://www.caiso.com/documents/publicqueuereport.xlsx
notes: Direct XLSX HEAD returned HTTP 200, spreadsheet content type, content-length 385093, Last-Modified 2026-08-11 08:00:26 GMT. Workbook sheets: Grid GenerationQueue, Completed Generation Projects, Withdrawn Generation Projects. Parsed counts: 273 active, 255 completed, 1765 withdrawn. Active fields include project name, queue position, request receive date, queue date, application status, study process, resource/fuel types, MW components, net MWs to grid, deliverability category and TPD allocation percentage.

name: SERC regional interconnection queue
pagination: Not applicable; no unified SERC project queue found.
fetch_method: curl -L https://www.serc.org/ and grep for queue/interconnection terms; inspected public homepage/navigation.
notes: SERC is a regional reliability entity, not an ISO/RTO queue operator. The public site is accessible, but it does not expose a unified project-level interconnection queue. For SERC-region planned projects, use member utility/transmission provider queues and OASIS sources such as Duke, Southern, TVA, Dominion non-PJM territories and other BA/TO queues.
